verdict.rationale: Paperspace's product page explicitly says users can "bring your SSH key and connect directly to your VM with full root access." Its docs confirm SSH connections to machines and an authentication choice at machine creation. One community user called getting SSH access "an uphill battle" because of the console-first GUI, which is a usability complaint rather than a failure of the capability, so it lowers confidence without making the claim disputed. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on uploading and managing SSH keys and on root/sudo configuration, and independent hands-on confirmation of a smooth key-based root SSH workflow.
